status: Experimental coordination candidate; not approved for construction
basis: Replace the vehicle-loaded garage/utility deck south of the basement stair with a suspended RC slab on the perimeter RC walls and strengthened cinema walls. Retain timber floor north of the cinema, on a shorter main steel girder. All dimensions are experimental; reinforcement, load spreading, foundations and connection designs remain unverified.

loads.limitations: Wheel/axle/load distribution and simultaneous actions are not assigned from inaccessible normative text. Use separate UDL and concentrated-load sensitivities. 1 m strip is an explicit modelling assumption, not a verified effective width. Verify the actual van maximum gross/axle weights and future vehicles.
